dialogues.jp: 暇つぶしになるかと、神社にやってきた。
dialogues.en: With nothing to do, I headed to the shrine.
dialogues.text: With nothing to do, I headed to the shrine.

dialogues.jp: 環がいるかもしれないし……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki might be there, after all...
dialogues.text: Tamaki might be there, after all...

dialogues.jp: 最初に言われたあの言葉……。
dialogues.en: Those words she said to me from the start...
dialogues.text: Those words she said to me from the start...

dialogues.jp: 俺と環の間には深い絆がある……。
dialogues.en: The supposed deep bond that we have...
dialogues.text: The supposed deep bond that we have...

dialogues.jp:
それが、俺達が｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝となっている根拠でもある
わけだが……。
dialogues.en: And, the very reason why we're supposed to be fiancees...
dialogues.text: And, the very reason why we're supposed to be fiancees...

dialogues.jp: 正直、さっぱり分からない。
dialogues.en:
To be perfectly honest, I completely didn't know anything
about it.
dialogues.text:
To be perfectly honest, I completely didn't know anything
about it.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、そのうちに分かることなのかも知れない
が……。
dialogues.en: Well, something might be known on her side of the fence...
dialogues.text: Well, something might be known on her side of the fence...

dialogues.jp:
環のことをもっとよく知れば、答えも早く見つ
かるかもしれないな。
dialogues.en:
The better I get to know Tamaki, the faster I'd find an
answer... probably.
dialogues.text:
The better I get to know Tamaki, the faster I'd find an
answer... probably.

dialogues.jp: 「ふう、やれやれ」
dialogues.en: "Whew, man."
dialogues.text: "Whew, man."

dialogues.jp: ここの石段は本当に手こずる。
dialogues.en: These flight of steps is a serious workout.
dialogues.text: These flight of steps is a serious workout.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、上りきった者にだけご利益があるってこ
となのかもしれないが……。
dialogues.en:
I suppose that's the trial to overcome, to attain the reward
from above...
dialogues.text:
I suppose that's the trial to overcome, to attain the reward
from above...

dialogues.jp: ご利益＝巫女装束の環、か？
dialogues.en: That is, Tamaki in her Miko outfit...
dialogues.text: That is, Tamaki in her Miko outfit...

dialogues.jp: 悪くはないよな。確かにかわいいし……。
dialogues.en:
Certainly something worth working for. She looks really cute
in it...
dialogues.text:
Certainly something worth working for. She looks really cute
in it...

dialogues.jp: い、いかん。動機が不純すぎる。
dialogues.en: Crap, I'm thinking bad things again.
dialogues.text: Crap, I'm thinking bad things again.

dialogues.jp: と、石段の途中でそのご利益に会う。
dialogues.en:
Just then, the "reward" appeared, as I finished scaling the
steps.
dialogues.text:
Just then, the "reward" appeared, as I finished scaling the
steps.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "My, good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "My, good afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
石畳を｛ほうき／箒｝ではたいていた環は、俺に気づいて笑
顔を見せる。
dialogues.en:
She was sweeping the stone pathways with a broom. Her face
lit up as she noticed who had greeted her.
dialogues.text:
She was sweeping the stone pathways with a broom. Her face
lit up as she noticed who had greeted her.

dialogues.jp: 「さっきまで、一緒の教室にいたけどな」
dialogues.en: "We haven't really talked much since, well, that time."
dialogues.text: "We haven't really talked much since, well, that time."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そういえば……そうですね」
dialogues.en: "That is true, now that you mention it."
dialogues.text: "That is true, now that you mention it."

dialogues.jp: つられたように環もクスっと笑う。
dialogues.en: "She giggled cutely at my observation.
dialogues.text: "She giggled cutely at my observation.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても大変だな、こんな広い場所の掃
　除なんて」
dialogues.en: "And you have to clean this huge place? Geez."
dialogues.text: "And you have to clean this huge place? Geez."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。これが巫女の務めですから……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. It is the duty of a Miko, after all..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. It is the duty of a Miko, after all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「巫女の務め、ね……」
dialogues.en: "The duty of a Miko, huh..."
dialogues.text: "The duty of a Miko, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は、今日はどうなさったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "And what might you be here for, Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "And what might you be here for, Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ご利益を得たいなあ、と」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing, I've already gotten my reward."
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing, I've already gotten my reward."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ご利益？　……何のですか？」
dialogues.en: "Reward? ...What might you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Reward? ...What might you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ま、気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Eh, don't mind me."
dialogues.text: "Eh, don't mind me."

dialogues.jp: 巫女装束の環とは口が裂けても言えない。
dialogues.en: I wouldn't say any more to the Miko-clad Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I wouldn't say any more to the Miko-clad Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、よくいらしてくれましたね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, before I forget; welcome to our shrine."
dialogues.text: "Ah, before I forget; welcome to our shrine."

dialogues.jp: 心なしか、弾んだ声で環は話す。
dialogues.en:
Without an ounce of refrain, her voice rang out loud and
true.
dialogues.text:
Without an ounce of refrain, her voice rang out loud and
true.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「こんなところでも何ですから、よろしければ、
　お茶でも召し上がりますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Whatever your purpose is, would you like to have some tea
first?"
dialogues.text:
"Whatever your purpose is, would you like to have some tea
first?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう、では有難く頂戴しよう」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yes please."
dialogues.text: "Oh, yes please."

dialogues.jp:
環の後ろについて行き、社務所の奥にある座敷
に座った。
dialogues.en:
I followed behind Tamaki to the shrine office, taking a seat
in the tatami mat-ridden room.
dialogues.text:
I followed behind Tamaki to the shrine office, taking a seat
in the tatami mat-ridden room.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Please."
dialogues.text: "Please."

dialogues.jp: 環がお茶を目の前に置く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki served a cup of tea to me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki served a cup of tea to me.

dialogues.jp: 「かたじけない」
dialogues.en: "Many thanks."
dialogues.text: "Many thanks."

dialogues.jp: ……って、
dialogues.en: ...Huh.
dialogues.text: ...Huh.

dialogues.jp: なぜか環と話していると、言語感覚が変になる。
dialogues.en: Why am I talking so weirdly, when I talk to her?
dialogues.text: Why am I talking so weirdly, when I talk to her?

dialogues.jp:
いつもは使っていないような言葉で会話をして
しまう。
dialogues.en: I'm usually pretty casual in my normal speech.
dialogues.text: I'm usually pretty casual in my normal speech.

dialogues.jp: 環の丁寧さに反発するものなのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's sheer politeness must be reflecting off me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's sheer politeness must be reflecting off me.

dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　神社のお茶って甘いって聞いたこと
　があるけど……」
dialogues.en:
"...Hrm? I've heard before that the shrine's tea was sweet,
but this isn't..."
dialogues.text:
"...Hrm? I've heard before that the shrine's tea was sweet,
but this isn't..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それは、お寺で飲む甘茶のことですね」
dialogues.en: "That would only be served at temples."
dialogues.text: "That would only be served at temples."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お寺だっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, at temples?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, at temples?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ここは神社ですから……」
dialogues.en: "And this is a mere shrine, so..."
dialogues.text: "And this is a mere shrine, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……俺の勘違いか」
dialogues.en: "...My mistake."
dialogues.text: "...My mistake."

dialogues.jp:
中途半端な知識で、環との会話を盛り上げよう
としたが、どうも出鼻でくじかれてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I shouldn't show my ignorance at something she's obviously
an expert on...
dialogues.text:
I shouldn't show my ignorance at something she's obviously
an expert on...

dialogues.jp:
会って間もないせいか、どうもまだ環という女
の子を掴みにくい。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention I've only just met her recently; I still
haven't really grappled onto what kind of girl she is.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention I've only just met her recently; I still
haven't really grappled onto what kind of girl she is.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・／許嫁｝だというのに。
dialogues.en: ...And she's supposed to be my fiancee.
dialogues.text: ...And she's supposed to be my fiancee.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、どうかなさいました？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, is something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に……」
dialogues.en: "No, nothing..."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing..."

dialogues.jp:
無駄に話を合わせずに、いつもの俺のペースで
話す方がいいかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Rather than talking about mindless things, I should just try
talking at my own pace.
dialogues.text:
Rather than talking about mindless things, I should just try
talking at my own pace.

dialogues.jp: 「平日の神社って、静かなんだな」
dialogues.en: "The shrine seems really quiet on weekdays."
dialogues.text: "The shrine seems really quiet on weekdays."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。祭りの時はすごく｛にぎ／賑｝やかですが」
dialogues.en: "Indeed. Our busiest times are during festivals."
dialogues.text: "Indeed. Our busiest times are during festivals."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ここは……神主さんを見ないけど、どうした
　の？」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't seen any... priests around, though. What's with
that?"
dialogues.text:
"I haven't seen any... priests around, though. What's with
that?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、以前の宮司が体調を壊してしまって」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, the previous chief priest encountered some health
problems."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, the previous chief priest encountered some health
problems."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「代わりに、わたくしの父が宮司を勤めること
　になったのですが……」
dialogues.en:
"My father was called in to take the place of chief priest
during the former chief priest's recuperation..."
dialogues.text:
"My father was called in to take the place of chief priest
during the former chief priest's recuperation..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女だけでもとりあえず早く来て欲しい、と
　言われて」
dialogues.en:
"And he needed a Miko around as well, to ensure the upkeep
of the shrine."
dialogues.text:
"And he needed a Miko around as well, to ensure the upkeep
of the shrine."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それでこの時期に転校してきたって訳か」
dialogues.en:
"So that's why you transferred to our school at this odd
time..."
dialogues.text:
"So that's why you transferred to our school at this odd
time..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい……。それに……学校のことも……」
dialogues.en: "Yes... and that school..."
dialogues.text: "Yes... and that school..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「学校のこと？」
dialogues.en: "That school?"
dialogues.text: "That school?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、い、いえ、何でもありません」
dialogues.en: "Ah, u, um, please forget what I said."
dialogues.text: "Ah, u, um, please forget what I said."

dialogues.jp: 環は急に、俺から目を反らす。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's eyes turned away, avoiding my gaze.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's eyes turned away, avoiding my gaze.

dialogues.jp: 「なにか、言いにくいことか？」
dialogues.en: "What were you trying to say?"
dialogues.text: "What were you trying to say?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、ちょっと困ったような表情を見せる。
dialogues.en: She seemed embarassed and worried at the same time.
dialogues.text: She seemed embarassed and worried at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、言いたくなかったらいいけど。困った
　ことがあったら言ってくれ。助けになるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if you don't want to talk about it, fine... but if
it's something worrying, let me know. I'd try my best to
help."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if you don't want to talk about it, fine... but if
it's something worrying, let me know. I'd try my best to
help."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。ありがとうございます。でも、大丈夫
　です」
dialogues.en: "I'm doing fine... but thank you."
dialogues.text: "I'm doing fine... but thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、気になってしまう。
dialogues.en: Or so I said, but I couldn't help wondering.
dialogues.text: Or so I said, but I couldn't help wondering.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、言いにくいことを無理に｛き／訊｝くことはな
いよな……。
dialogues.en:
But it looks like saying what it is would really be too much
for her...
dialogues.text:
But it looks like saying what it is would really be too much
for her...

dialogues.jp:
「ところで、前から気になってたんだけど、巫
　女って実際は何をしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, I was thinking about this earlier... what
exactly does a Miko actually do?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, I was thinking about this earlier... what
exactly does a Miko actually do?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は別の方向に話を振ることにした。
dialogues.en: A change of direction in the conversation might be best.
dialogues.text: A change of direction in the conversation might be best.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。色々なことをしますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, our job cannot be defined very easily. Miko tend to
do several different things."
dialogues.text:
"Well, our job cannot be defined very easily. Miko tend to
do several different things."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様は、巫女はどんなことをしてるとお思
　いですか？」
dialogues.en:
"What comes to your mind, when you think about the duties of
a Miko, Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text:
"What comes to your mind, when you think about the duties of
a Miko, Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.jp: 質問を質問で返してきた。なかなかやるな。
dialogues.en: Answering my question with a question, huh. Not bad...
dialogues.text: Answering my question with a question, huh. Not bad...

dialogues.jp:
「そうだなぁ……。おみくじを売ったり、お札
　を売ったり……」
dialogues.en: "Well... selling oracle scrolls, and charms..."
dialogues.text: "Well... selling oracle scrolls, and charms..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それから？」
dialogues.en: "And?"
dialogues.text: "And?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うーん」
巫女装束で、参拝にくる人の心を和ませる。
dialogues.en: A costume-clad figure that worshippers feel peace at?
dialogues.text: A costume-clad figure that worshippers feel peace at?

dialogues.jp: んな訳はないか……。
dialogues.en: But that isn't just it...
dialogues.text: But that isn't just it...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だいたい当たってますね」
dialogues.en: "You are more or less correct."
dialogues.text: "You are more or less correct."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、いくらなんでもそれだけじゃないよな」
dialogues.en: "Surely that isn't all, though."
dialogues.text: "Surely that isn't all, though."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あとは、境内の掃除もそうですが、お茶やお
　花や琴や舞も習うんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"There is also the maintenance of the shrine area, and the
learning of customs such as flowers, tea, the harp..."
dialogues.text:
"There is also the maintenance of the shrine area, and the
learning of customs such as flowers, tea, the harp..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「へえ。そんなことも習うんだ。すごいな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, you learn all that... amazing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, you learn all that... amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お祭りの際、祈願者の前で舞うんです」
dialogues.en:
"Before festivals begin, we are also required to perform a
ritual dance in front of the worshippers."
dialogues.text:
"Before festivals begin, we are also required to perform a
ritual dance in front of the worshippers."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そういや、そんなの見たことがあるな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, I remember something like that."
dialogues.text: "Heh, I remember something like that."

dialogues.jp:
ううむ、巫女ってのは、大変なんだな。カワイ
イ服を着てるだけじゃないらしい。
dialogues.en:
Man, Miko have it pretty tough. They're definitely not just
wearing cute costumes.
dialogues.text:
Man, Miko have it pretty tough. They're definitely not just
wearing cute costumes.

dialogues.jp:
「な、な、その舞ってやつ、ちょっと見せてく
　れない？」
dialogues.en:
"H, hey, could I have a glimpse of that dance you
mentioned?"
dialogues.text:
"H, hey, could I have a glimpse of that dance you
mentioned?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしの……舞ですか？」
dialogues.en: "My... dance?"
dialogues.text: "My... dance?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「習ってるんだろ？　見てみたいんだ」
dialogues.en: "You have learnt it, right? I want to see it."
dialogues.text: "You have learnt it, right? I want to see it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ……でも、まだお見せする程のものでは」
dialogues.en: "Yes... but it is not something worth watching, yet."
dialogues.text: "Yes... but it is not something worth watching, yet."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そっか……、残念だ。でも、いつか見せてく
　れると嬉しいな」
dialogues.en:
"I see... oh well. I'd be glad to watch it whenever you're
ready, though."
dialogues.text:
"I see... oh well. I'd be glad to watch it whenever you're
ready, though."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……ではいずれ」
dialogues.en: "I will keep that in mind."
dialogues.text: "I will keep that in mind."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、楽しみにしてるよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it'd be fun."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it'd be fun."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「よろしければ、今度、朝倉様にも舞を教えま
　しょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps I could teach you about the ritual dance, as well?"
dialogues.text: "Perhaps I could teach you about the ritual dance, as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女だけじゃなく、男の方も踊ることはある
　んですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The dance is not just for Miko to perform, men can perform
it as well."
dialogues.text:
"The dance is not just for Miko to perform, men can perform
it as well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「男の舞、ねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "A man's dance, eh..."
dialogues.text: "A man's dance, eh..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、巫女の踊りに、男の姿を当てはめる。赤
と白の袴を身にまとったひげ面の男の踊りが脳
裏に浮かぶ。
dialogues.en:
My imagination started running, with the thought of a male
performing a woman's dance, in full red and white hakama...
dialogues.text:
My imagination started running, with the thought of a male
performing a woman's dance, in full red and white hakama...

dialogues.jp:
「ダメダメ、男の舞なんて、やってらんないっ
　ての」
dialogues.en: "N, no thanks, I don't think I could do it."
dialogues.text: "N, no thanks, I don't think I could do it."

dialogues.jp:
人前であんな格好をして踊るなんて、とんでも
ない。かったるすぎる。
dialogues.en:
Dancing like that in full public view, that'd be way too
troublesome...
dialogues.text:
Dancing like that in full public view, that'd be way too
troublesome...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。気が変わったら言って下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Alright. If you ever change your mind, let me know."
dialogues.text: "Alright. If you ever change your mind, let me know."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「変わったらな」
dialogues.en: "I won't."
dialogues.text: "I won't."

dialogues.jp: おそらくは、ないだろう……。
dialogues.en: No way that'd happen...
dialogues.text: No way that'd happen...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、しばらく環と時間を過ごした。
dialogues.en: Time passed quickly, spending it with Tamaki like that.
dialogues.text: Time passed quickly, spending it with Tamaki like that.

dialogues.jp:
環が掃除の続きをしなければならないとのこと
なので、家に帰ることにした。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had to concentrate on her cleaning to finish it, so I
went home.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had to concentrate on her cleaning to finish it, so I
went home.

dialogues.jp:
結局、環のことや許嫁のことは、大してわから
なかったが、巫女の知識が身についただけでも
今日は収穫としよう。
dialogues.en:
In the end, I didn't know any more about our supposed
fiancee connection, but I learnt a lot about Miko.
dialogues.text:
In the end, I didn't know any more about our supposed
fiancee connection, but I learnt a lot about Miko.

dialogues.jp: ご利益があるかもしれない。
dialogues.en: It wasn't a bad tradeoff, overall.
dialogues.text: It wasn't a bad tradeoff, overall.

dialogues.jp: 環のことは、おいおいわかってくるに違いない。
dialogues.en: I'm also slowly learning more and more about Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I'm also slowly learning more and more about Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
少なくとも、この時期に転校してきた理由もわ
かった訳だし。
dialogues.en:
And at least, I found out the reason why she transferred
schools at this time, as well.
dialogues.text:
And at least, I found out the reason why she transferred
schools at this time, as well.

dialogues.jp: 気になることも言っていたけれど……。
dialogues.en: But it doesn't seem like the entire reason...
dialogues.text: But it doesn't seem like the entire reason...

dialogues.jp: ◆転校の理由◆
dialogues.en: ◆Season Of Transference?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Season Of Transference?◆

dialogues.jp: 神社へ行くと、環が石段を掃除していた。
dialogues.en:
I headed to the shrine, and found Tamaki sweeping the stone
steps.
dialogues.text:
I headed to the shrine, and found Tamaki sweeping the stone
steps.

dialogues.jp:
お茶を勧められて話をすると、環が転校してき
た理由を聞かされた。
dialogues.en:
While having a cup of tea with her, I found out why she
moved here at such an odd time.
dialogues.text:
While having a cup of tea with her, I found out why she
moved here at such an odd time.

dialogues.jp:
ここの宮司が体調を崩し、そのために環の家族
が呼ばれたらしい。
dialogues.en:
The chief priest's health had deteroriated, so her family
was called here.
dialogues.text:
The chief priest's health had deteroriated, so her family
was called here.

dialogues.jp: 他にも理由がありそうだったが……。
dialogues.en: But there seems to be some other reason...
dialogues.text: But there seems to be some other reason...
